title: [arena · C07] Which of these bills comes back every month?
body:
> **Arena · C07.** A 8-minute challenge, **fill** format, from notebook 07 §7.1.
> Post your answer as a comment. A sealed sandbox runs it and replies within about a minute with
> what passed, what did not, what you can now do, and what to try next.

🟢 [`C07` — Which of these bills comes back every month?](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/labs/C07-recurring-or-one-off/brief.md) · track T6 (Viability)

> Capex-shaped costs are decisions you make twice a year. Opex-shaped costs are bills you pay daily. Blending them into one per-query number hides which is which.

## How to submit

Paste the completed file — every `____` replaced — in a ```` ```python ```` block.

Every attempt is counted, not only the first — retrying **is** the exercise. The reply names the
specific check that failed and why, so re-post when you have changed something.

Each attempt also moves your row on the [Hands-on Tracker](https://github.com/users/akash-coded/projects/11) — *Attempted*, then
*Retrying*, then *Passed* — with the count. A pass never turns back into *Retrying* because you
re-posted out of curiosity.

## Zero setup

[![Open in GitHub Codespaces](https://github.com/codespaces/badge.svg)](https://codespaces.new/akash-coded/nanorag?quickstart=1)

```bash
python scripts/lab.py open C07      # brief on one side, starter on the other
python scripts/lab.py run C07
python scripts/lab.py run C07 --hidden
```

## What runs your code, and why it is safe to post here

Your submission runs in a container with **no network, a read-only filesystem, no capabilities,
an unprivileged user and a 30-second kill** — inside a workflow job that holds **no credentials
at all**. The job that posts the reply never sees your code; it reads a JSON report. Anyone can
comment on a public thread, so the sandbox is built on the assumption that someone will post
something hostile, and it would find nothing to reach.

## When you pass

**Unlocks:** [`L10`](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/labs/L10-cost-and-cache/brief.md) — Price the 69% of the bill that is not generation

The reply will say why that one comes next. If you would rather argue with the debrief than move
on, the [track thread](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/discussions?discussions_q=label%3Alab) is the place.
